visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular Asian man in his late 20s or 30s stands in a modern, dark-toned kitchen. He is shirtless, showcasing a highly defined physique with visible six-pack abs and large pectoral muscles. He wears a black baseball cap and white shorts. A detailed rose tattoo is visible on his right forearm. He stares directly into the lens with a stoic, neutral facial expression while standing still against the background of dark cabinetry. (2) The man lifts his right arm to hold up a blue and white plastic bottle, appearing to be a supplement container. White Chinese text overlays appear at the top, and smaller text identifying the bottle as "Calcium and Magnesium" appears nearby. His facial expression remains steady and focused on the camera, emphasizing the product he is presenting to the viewer in a clear, central manner. (3) In a sudden cut, the man is now holding about six or seven different supplement bottles, some gripped in his hands and others tucked under his armpits. His arms are flexed to hold the items. Brightly colored labels in various hues like yellow, green, and blue appear on the screen, each pointing to a different bottle. A subtitle appears at the bottom explaining the importance of nutrition and providing a specific discount code for the audience.
